name: @gz2016/dsh-plugin-voice-loop
description: Fully self-contained hands-free full-screen voice interface: continuous mic capture with adaptive, noise-floor-tracking auto-stop, transcribed via a swappable STT backend (local Qwen3-ASR or cloud Qwen3-ASR-Flash by default), replies read aloud via a swappable TTS backend (local Qwen3-TTS or Edge TTS by default). Real barge-in cancels an in-flight reply server-side, the same RPC the core composer's own stop button uses, not just muting playback. The local/cloud backend choice (per-request, from the client's own quick toggle) is decoupled from which endpoint/model each one actually calls (per-deployment, editable from DSH's own Settings page) - point either backend at your own OpenAI-compatible server. Renders as a fixed-position view from a composer toggle (conversation.input.left); also registers a Settings > Plugins tab. Plan-review/question prompts are announced aloud and handed off to the normal on-screen panel rather than answered by voice.
author: ZG2017
